visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a grey t-shirt and glasses leans toward the camera, his face showing signs of exhaustion as he touches his nose and forehead. He is in a brightly lit kitchen featuring white cabinets and a large stainless steel refrigerator. Yellow and white captions appear on the screen. (2) The scene shifts to a restaurant with a warm, ambient glow. The man and a woman sit at a wooden table topped with a large breakfast spread including eggs, sausages, and salad. The woman uses a fork to eat while the man gestures toward the massive meal. Subtitles appear at the bottom. (3) In a modern kitchen, the man claps his hands and begins preparing a meal. He wears a beige shirt and uses a knife to chop celery, carrots, and mushrooms on a wooden board. The countertop is clean and well-lit. Variety-style text labels indicate the ingredients being sliced. (4) The man places a whole fish into a large glass dish, stuffing its cavity with aromatics like green onions. He surrounds the fish with a colorful mix of vegetables and pours seasonings from glass bottles. The scene uses fast-cut editing to show the assembly process. (5) The man operates a sleek steam oven, sliding the dish inside and pressing buttons. The video cuts to him in the living room area, where he performs squats and core exercises with a heavy black kettlebell. His movements are focused and rhythmic. Text overlays track his activity. (6) He removes the finished dish from the oven using a blue mitt, releasing a cloud of steam. He pours a prepared soy-based sauce over the fish and vegetables. Finally, he sits at a table and uses chopsticks to lift a piece of tender white fish, offering a close-up view to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with the heavy, labored breathing of a man, suggesting physical exertion. An upbeat, acoustic pop track with a steady guitar rhythm begins playing. His voice is initially low and tired as he speaks, punctuated by soft sighs. The BGM has a friendly, lighthearted vibe. (2) A loud, sharp hand-clap sounds, transitioning to a higher energy narration. The male speaker's voice is now clear and fast-paced, describing the cooking steps with high arousal. Rhythmic, percussive chopping sounds of a knife hitting a wooden surface create a syncopated layer over the background music. (3) Acoustic details include the rustling of plastic vegetable packaging and the faint sound of running water. The man's tone is professional yet casual. The BGM continues with a bright piano melody and a soft drum beat, maintaining a steady, moderate tempo throughout the instructional segment. (4) Sounds of mechanical operation, like the clicking of an oven door and electronic beeps from a touchpad, are clearly audible. During a transition to exercise, the sound of heavy breathing returns, accompanied by the percussive thud of a kettlebell landing on the floor. (5) The final phase features the clinking of a ceramic spoon against a bowl as a sauce is mixed, followed by a pouring sound. The narrator's voice adopts a more relaxed, satisfied tone as he tastes the food. Utensil clicks and chewing sounds are audible in the mix before he signs off.
